item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 15/Aug/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring generally fine weather to southeastern China today and tomorrow. An area of low pressure is expected to affect the northern part of the South China Sea in the middle and latter parts of this week, and bring showers and thunderstorms to the coast of Guangdong. With the anticyclone aloft strengthening again early next week, the weather will improve over southern China.
